description: Commercial and Industrial Waste 2014-15 is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. The commercial and industrial waste (C&I) data represents total waste produced per year by ABS statistical area 2 (SA2) boundaries. The figures represent the total C&I waste that is produced by institutions and businesses; including waste from schools, restaurants, offices, retail and wholesale businesses, and industries including manufacturing for the 2014-15 period. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Its tags are WA-WS. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
